#include <iostream>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    long long rem = x;
    long long best_num = 0;
    long long best_den = 1;

    for (long long b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
        long long a = max(x * b / y - 10, 0LL);
        for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {
            long long candidate_a = a + j;
            long long diff = abs(x * b - candidate_a * y);
            if (rem * b > diff * best_den) {
                rem = diff;
                best_num = candidate_a;
                best_den = b;
            } else if (rem * b == diff * best_den) {
                if (best_den > b || (best_den == b && best_num > candidate_a)) {
                    best_num = candidate_a;
                    best_den = b;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << best_num << "/" << best_den << endl;
}
